hazards.evidence: White toilet seat and white toilet on a light-colored floor create low contrast, making it difficult for someone with dementia to perceive the toilet clearly.
A dark bath mat on a light floor can be a tripping hazard and may be difficult for someone with dementia to see, increasing the risk of falls.
A plugged-in hair dryer is placed near the sink, posing a risk of electrical shock or burns if it is accidentally turned on or dropped into water.
